label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y darás los dos cordones del oro sobre los dos los anillos a extremos del joshen.
spanish: Y darás los dos cordones del oro sobre los dos anillos a extremos del pectoral.
grammarChanges: Replaced the untranslated Hebraized lemma 'joshen' with the Spanish common noun 'pectoral' for h02028024011, per auditor fail.
Removed the duplicated definite article in 'los dos los anillos', yielding 'los dos anillos' (one dual numeral, one definite plural, same referent), per auditor warn.
